content:
Maya: incident-bot: paging: infra-critical: inference-serving-high-error-rate — triggered at 12:07 UTC
incident-bot: Page sent to @Sam (on-call)
Sam: saw the page, joining...
Maya: errors spike across us-east-1 for inference-service, errors ~5xx 45% higher than baseline
Jon: looks like log stream shows repeated "kv-cache miss - eviction" entries and some OOM traces
Lina: @Sam any customer-facing impact yet? CCM said 1 customer reported slow responses
Sam: 1) serving p95 latency up from 120ms -> 520ms; 2) error rate for generation endpoints up from 0.3% -> 3.2%
Carlos: I'm pulling pod logs and tailing host metrics now
Sam: quick mitigation: flip canary to fallback model in us-east-1 and scale up pool by +2 nodes — Lina can you approve? :thumbsup:
Lina: approved, do it
deploy-bot: rollback/canary switch initiated by Sam at 12:12 UTC
Maya: I'm adding an emergency filter to the frontend to return 503 with retry-after for heavy requests to reduce load
Jon: attaching sample log pattern I'm seeing:
```
2026-03-15T12:06:53Z inference svc[worker-7]: ERROR kv-cache miss, allocate failed: memory_exhausted at lru_cache.cpp:342
2026-03-15T12:06:54Z inference svc[worker-7]: WARN process killed by OOM-killer pid=2345
```
Maya: customer impact: small set of batch inference jobs delayed, interactive chat degraded for a few tenants — CS notified
Sam: handoff: I'll own live mitigation until 12:45 UTC, then pass to Maya for postmortem
Jon: mitigation status: fallback model enabled, +2 nodes added, error rate dropping to ~1.1% now
Carlos: good, saving logs for post-incident analysis
incident-bot: Incident annotated: severity=sev2, start=1799123456, mitigation=partial
Sam: after-action notes — we are noisy on the error alert that's tied to raw log counts. We had many benign kv-cache messages during GC that shouldn't page
Maya: agreed. Proposal: change alert from count>100 in 5m to rate-based >0.8/min and exclude healthcheck and gc traces via regex
Jon: suggested new log query (LogQL):
```
sum(rate({app="inference",env="prod"} |= "kv-cache" |~ "memory_exhausted|OOM-killer" [5m])) by (region)
```
Maya: add a negative match to ignore gc logs: |!="gc-collect"
Carlos: also recommend adding signature for "kv-cache allocate failed" with severity=warning so it doesn't create pager noise
Lina: also create a dashboard tile for region-level kv-cache eviction rate and per-model p95 latency
Sam: action items:
- Sam: update alert rule (query + rate threshold) and add regex exclude — due 13:30 UTC
- Jon: add signature mapping in logging pipeline — due EOD
- Maya: dashboard + notes in runbook — due EOD
- Carlos: archive raw logs to incident bundle
Maya: cc @oncall: please review runbook changes before next rotation
Sam: once rules updated I'll monitor for 2 hours and then close incident
Lina: thanks all — postmortem to be scheduled tomorrow
Maya: marking this thread resolved, moving post-incident work to task tracker :white_check_mark:
